objects.description: [ShinyHunters](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1057) has used MeshCentral and [ConnectWise](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0591) to gain initial access, to run administrative command queries and to deploy the custom lateral movement and defacement script [victim_abbreviation]_fanout.sh.(Citation: Google_SHOracle_Jun2026)(Citation: ElecticIQ Buyukkaya_ShinyHunters_Sept2025)
